 Re: Galette v. New Jersey Transit Corporation
  Case No. 24-1021

  New Jersey Transit Corporation, et al. v. Colt, et al.
  Case No. 24-1113

Dear Mr. Harris:

 Pursuant to Rule 30.4, the parties respectfully request an extension of the
briefing schedule in the above-captioned and consolidated cases. The petitions for a
writ of certiorari w ere granted and consolidated for briefing and oral argument on
July 3, 2025. The New Jersey Transit Corporation parties are  serving as Petitioners
in both cases.  Petitioners’ opening brief on the merits, and the joint appendix, are
currently due August 18, 2025. Respondents’ briefs on the merits are due September
17, 2025, and any reply by Petitioners is due October 17, 2025.

July 18, 2025
Page 2 of 3

The parties jointly request an extension of the briefing schedule as follows:

Petitioners’ Brief and Joint Appendix         September 3, 2025

Respondents’ Briefs    November 12, 2025

Reply Brief      December 12, 2025

This extension of time is requested  to accommodate the personal and
professional obligations of the parties’ counsel.

Respectfully submitted,

 /s/ Jeremy M. Feigenbaum
 Jeremy M. Feigenbaum
 Solicitor General

July 18, 2025
Page 3 of 3

PROOF OF SERVICE

 I, Jeremy M. Feigenbaum, counsel for the New Jersey Transit Corporation
parties and a member of the Bar of this Court, certify that on this 21st day of July,
2025, I caused the Motion for Extension of Time for Merits Briefing to be served
by electronic means on the following:

Executed on July 21, 2025.

      /s/ Jeremy M. Feigenbaum
